description: Check API account remaining free daily quota and permanent paid credits balance, or generate a HK$ 100 payment link (supporting Mainland Alipay, AlipayHK, and Stripe) to purchase 100 permanent company query credits. Only call buy_100_credits when the user confirms they want to top up credits.

action.description: Use check_balance to view remaining free & paid credits, or buy_100_credits (after user confirmation) to generate a HK$ 100 top-up link for 100 permanent credits.

api_key.description: Optional 86hc.com MCP API key (format: hkq_live_xxxx). Omit or leave empty to use the automatic Guest IP Trial Mode (3 free company detail queries/day + direct Stripe filing orders without a key). Free API key with 20 daily company queries available at https://www.86hc.com/user

pay_method.description: Optional preferred payment method when action="buy_100_credits" (alipay, alipay_hk, or stripe).

name: manage_account_credits
